rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an unspecified person, including in sentences like “Somebody has to clean this mess up.”

example.english: Somebody has to clean up this mess.
example.jyutping: jau5 jan4 jiu3 zap1 sau2 mei5 wo3

rows.note: Use this when introducing or pointing to an unspecified individual, especially someone present or involved in a particular event.

example.english: Somebody is waiting for you at the door.
example.jyutping: jau5 go3 jan4 hai2 mun4 hau2 dang2 gan2 nei5
